actions.name: gore
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended average]]. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition.

actions.name: petrifying breath
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=reU3RXAk0MdPmKCl]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=reU3RXAk0MdPmKCl]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=reU3RXAk0MdPmKCl]]-foot Cone. First Failure: The target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the &Reference[Petrified apply=false] condition instead of the Restrained condition.

actions.name: trample
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=QckCIpsC3BdEHycI]], [[lookup @target.affects.labels.statblock activity=QckCIpsC3BdEHycI]] within [[lookup @range.value activity=QckCIpsC3BdEHycI]] feet that has the Prone condition. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Success: [[lookup @damage.onSave capitalize activity=QckCIpsC3BdEHycI]] damage.
